01

Dungeon Entry

Dungeon Finder, daily reset, and private instances

Dungeons are private instance activities used for progression, experience, loot boxes, and dungeon-specific rewards. Solo and Greater Dungeons now work as a daily reset system instead of old stacked charges. The daily entrance resets at server rollover and does not stack.

Use the Dungeon Finder from the game interface to check your current available dungeon entries and the dungeon type you can run.

Image laterDungeon Finder and daily entry UI
02

Solo, Greater, and Golden Dungeons

Dungeon types and when they matter

Solo Dungeons are built for one player. Greater Dungeons are party content and are usually worth doing when the group has enough clear speed to make the run efficient.

Dungeon typeUseEntry behavior
Solo DungeonSingle-player dungeon run for daily progression.Uses the daily Solo Dungeon entrance shown in Dungeon Finder.
Greater DungeonGroup dungeon run with stronger scaling and rewards.Uses the daily Greater Dungeon entrance shown in Dungeon Finder.
Golden DungeonRare hybrid dungeon that can appear from Solo or Greater starts.Small chance when starting a Solo or Greater Dungeon.
03

Raid Boss Dungeons

Kraken, Sarandiel, Forgemaster, and Raid Points

Raid Boss Dungeons are boss-focused dungeon instances tied to Forgotten Islands progression. They are different from regular Solo or Greater Dungeons because the run centers around one major raid boss, boss mechanics, shard/token rewards, and Raid Points.

The main raid dungeon bosses to document here are Kraken, Sarandiel, and Forge Master. These fights are linked to Forgotten Islands areas and should be treated as high-value boss dungeons, not normal clear-speed dungeons.

Image laterRaid Boss Dungeon entrance, boss room, or reward NPC
Raid dungeonAssociated areaMain reward focusPlayer notes
KrakenBlackridge / Kraken Defense NavyKraken equipment, Kraken Shards, Raid PointsFight uses ship/tentacle mechanics. Avoid being surrounded by tentacles and watch for boss mechanics.
SarandielForgotten Islands raid contentSarandiel companion reward path, Sarandiel Shards, Raid PointsRequires strong blocking and mechanic dodging. Some related access or spawn content may require island progression.
Forge MasterAzmar Sands / Forge Master contentForge Master weapons, Forge Master tokens/shards, Raid PointsVery dangerous boss fight. Tanks and shooters both need to respect mechanics.

Completing Raid Dungeons grants Raid Points. Raid Points are used with Alvaro for raid-related rewards, including equipment and listed shop items.

Raid Boss Dungeon Reset Tokens may appear through active shops or reward pools. When available, they are used to reset or access the raid boss dungeon loop again.

04

Dungeon Rewards

Dungeon Loot Boxes, Raid Points, scaling, furniture, and bonus boxes

Dungeons grant Dungeon Loot Boxes. Dungeon scaling affects how many boxes players receive, while bonuses such as prestige bonuses and global dungeon potions can add extra boxes.

Dungeon-related furniture no longer grants extra charges. Instead, dungeon furniture supports dungeon runs by increasing rewards, including experience and reward loot bags.

Reward sourceWhat it does
Dungeon Loot BoxesMain dungeon reward box type across dungeon tiers.
Dungeon scalingImpacts the amount of Dungeon Loot Boxes received.
Dungeon furnitureSupports dungeon reward gain instead of adding stacked charges.
Prestige and dungeon potionsCan add extra dungeon boxes.
Raid Boss DungeonsGrant Raid Points and boss-specific reward paths such as equipment, companion tokens, shards, or weapon rewards.
